title: 潘功胜：香港国际金融中心优势独特
speaker: Pan Gongsheng

segments.en: With our joint efforts, those policies are already in place and helping Hong Kong to develop into a better financial hub.
segments.zh: 通过共同努力，这些政策已经落地，助力香港发展成为更完善的金融中心。

segments.en: Looking ahead for the future, Hong Kong is striving to be a better international financial hub with better prosperity and a higher region.
segments.zh: 展望未来，香港正努力成为更繁荣、更高水平的国际金融中心。

segments.en: Hong Kong is open and prosperous in business. The infrastructure here is modern, legal system is complete and the monetary and regulatory are international level.
segments.zh: 香港商业开放繁荣，基础设施现代化，法律体系完善，货币与监管达到国际水平。

segments.en: We have a lot of the talent gathering here which supports the diversified complete ecosystem for the financial industry.
segments.zh: 大量人才汇聚于此，支撑起金融业多元化、完整的生态系统。

segments.en: In addition, Hong Kong is adjacent to the mainland China, it is a strength. We are facing a lot of uncertainty, capital of the market are diversifying the allocation of investment.
segments.zh: 此外，香港毗邻内地，这是一大优势。我们面临诸多不确定性，市场资本正在分散配置。

segments.en: They are tracking the balance of efficiency and regulatory regressness. Hong Kong connects the overseas market with the mainland once.
segments.zh: 他们在权衡效率与监管的平衡。香港将海外市场与内地紧密连接。
